title: Apple Launch Day Deals on iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5, Apple Watch Series 12, and More
content:
Apple's newest products launch today, including the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, AirPods 5, Apple Watch Series 12, and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Many of these devices have launch discounts available at various retailers, all of which you can find below.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

AirPods and Apple Watch Launch Day



  • What's the deal? Get launch deals on AirPods 5 and Apple Watch Series 12

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$4 OFF
AirPods 5 for $124.99

$9 OFF

$9 OFF

The AirPods 5, Apple Watch Series 12, and Apple Watch Ultra 4 all launch today, and there are a few initial deals on some model available on Amazon. Although these discounts are small, if you're looking to buy Apple's newest products on launch day, they're the best sales you'll find online.

iPhone 18 Pro



  • What's the deal? Get launch deals on iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max

  • Where can I get it? AT&T and Verizon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

UP TO $1,200 OFF
iPhone 18 Pro at AT&T

UP TO $1,200 OFF
iPhone 18 Pro at Verizon


It's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launch day, and you can find the usual carrier offers from AT&T, Verizon, and more on the new devices. The popular offer this year is up to $1,200 off the iPhone 18 Pro with eligible device trade-in on select unlimited plans.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories



  • What's the deal? Save on color-matched accessories for your iPhone 18 Pro

  • Where can I get it? Anker and Satechi


$5 OFF
Anker Nano Charger for $34.99

PRE-ORDER
Anker MagGo 2 Pro Magnetic Power Bank for $109.99


If you're buying the new iPhone 18 Pro, you might be shopping for matching accessories, and popular accessory companies like Anker and Satechi have introduced a few color-matched accessories for the new burgundy color. This includes the MagGo 2 Pro Magnetic Power Bank from Anker and more.

Mac Mini and Mac Studio Pre-Orders

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,449.99

$19 OFF

$29 OFF

$29 OFF

Amazon recently introduced the first cash discounts on Apple's brand new Mac mini and Mac Studio, with discounts reaching up to $49 off original prices. All of these deals are pre-order discounts on the 2026 Mac mini and Mac Studio, which officially launches on September 22.
